SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：Shanghai Municipal Police / C.I.D REGISTRY / Foreign Detection Station, / No. 9878 / Date 20. 6. 29.）
Date June 19, 1929.

Subject (in full) P. Nossoff.

Made by D. S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Thos Rulleston C-D.1.

Information has been received to the effect that
P. Nossoff, former manager of the local branch of Soviet Textile
Syndicate, who was dismissed from that post in 1928 is at
present one of the organizers of the Russian Emigrant's Coopera-
tive Store at 355 Avenue Joffre and a member of its Committee.

B. Maklaevsky
D. S.

HR 19/6/29.
Copy to: H.B.M.C.S.
Col. Halland,
Capt. Colasmit,
Lieut Carlson.
C. Y. M.

N/D. C. I.
19/6/29.

NOSSOFF, P.    Soviet

At present one of the organizers of Russian Emigrant's

20 June 1929

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
CENTRAL I.B.2 Station
Date December 17, 1928
File No. 9848
Subject (in full) Activities of local bolsheviks.
Made by D.S. Owsianikoff Forwarded by J.P. Givens a.b. Pol
Information has been received to the effect
that Comrades Stepoonin and P. Nosoff, former employees of the
late Textile Syndicate, 4 Kiungse Road, are organizing a private
agency in Shanghai for the importation of Soviet petroleum
products. Several prominent Chinese merchants are reported to
be financially interested in the concern.
V. Ovsianikoff
D.S.
